study.title: Niu-OSS-Dashboard
study.tagline: Situs yang sedang Anda baca — dasbor yang mengaudit dirinya sendiri.
study.problem: Portofolio developer biasanya berhenti di 'daftar proyek' — tidak ada bukti hidup bahwa sistemnya cepat, jujur soal datanya, dan benar-benar berjalan. Klaim performa tak bisa diverifikasi pengunjung.

approach.title: Statis murni + 3D yang sopan
approach.text: 214 halaman statis tanpa ISR, hero 3D performance-aware yang degrade rapi saat WebGL lemah — pelajaran pahit dari bug hydration #418 yang pernah melumpuhkan produksi.

approach.title: GitOps ala Upptime
approach.text: GitHub Actions mengecek 10 situs ekosistem tiap 15 menit dan meng-commit hasilnya — /status membaca data ter-commit, bisa diaudit siapa saja.

approach.title: Mengaudit dirinya sendiri
approach.text: CSP report-only dengan endpoint laporan, E2E hidrasi 12/12 di CI, API publik v1 (107 endpoint), dan CHANGELOG yang di-render jadi halaman — situs ini membukukan bukti-buktinya sendiri.

study.outcome: niumination.web.id live: 90 repo teragregasi live dari API GitHub (bukan angka ketikan), kalender kontribusi 12 bulan via GraphQL, uptime yang bisa dicek publik, dan seluruh perjalanan perbaikannya tercatat di CHANGELOG.

en.tagline: The site you are reading right now — a dashboard that audits itself.
en.problem: A developer portfolio usually stops at 'a list of projects' — no living proof that the system is fast, honest about its data, and actually running. Performance claims the visitor cannot verify.

approach.title: Purely static + polite 3D
approach.text: 214 static pages with no ISR, and a performance-aware 3D hero that degrades gracefully on weak WebGL — a hard lesson from the hydration bug #418 that once crippled production.

approach.title: Upptime-style GitOps
approach.text: GitHub Actions checks 10 ecosystem sites every 15 minutes and commits the results — /status reads committed data anyone can audit.

approach.title: Auditing itself
approach.text: Report-only CSP with a reporting endpoint, 12/12 hydration E2E in CI, a public v1 API (107 endpoints), and a CHANGELOG rendered as a page — this site documents its own evidence.

en.outcome: niumination.web.id live: 90 repos aggregated live from the GitHub API (not typed numbers), a full 12-month GraphQL contribution calendar, publicly auditable uptime, and its entire repair journey recorded in the CHANGELOG.
